release.excerpt: New Ticket feature: Tickets are a mechanism to prepare and send certain transactions outside of the normal sequence order. This version reworks and completes the implementation for Tickets after more than 6 years of development. This feature is now open for voting as the newly-introduced TicketBatch

prs.title: Make TicketBatch a SupportedAmendment so it can be enabled.
prs.author: scottschurr
prs.body:
## High Level Overview of Change

`TicketBatch` has been in the code base for a while, but it has not been part of the `SupportedAmendments`.  This was to prevent accidental enablement.

Since we're thinking that it may make sense to enable `TicketBatch` after the release of 1.7.0 this commit adds it to `SupportedAmendments`.  The commit also removes a number of workarounds in the unit tests.  The workarounds are no longer needed now that `TicketBatch` is in `SupportedAmendments`.

This commit does not to be reflected in the release notes, unless it is to note that `TicketBatch` is a `SupportedAmendment` with all of the attendant risks and benefits :wink:

### Type of Change

- [x] Allow feature to be enabled on the network.

## Future Tasks

Shepherd the `TicketBatch` amendment once it attains 80% support on the network.
prs.head: scottschurr:enable-ticket-batch
